content.title: WNBA Draft 2026
content.text: Dallas Wings Select Azzi Fudd No. 1 OverallThe WNBA Draft 2026 is complete! Topping the board, the Wings took Azzi Fudd with the first overall pick. In a roster shakeup, the Valkyries selected and traded Flau'jae Johnson to the Storm, receiving Marta Suárez and a 2028 second-round selection in return.
